editorial:
If you grew up playing Nintendo games, this movie feels like a warm hug. Mario and Luigi are Brooklyn plumbers who get sucked into a magical world through a mysterious pipe. When they get separated, Mario teams up with Princess Peach and Toad to rescue Luigi from the evil Bowser. The whole thing is bright, colorful, and packed with little nods to the games you love. It moves fast and never takes itself too seriously, which makes it a perfect pick for a fun family night.

The animation looks amazing, especially the Rainbow Road chase and the big final battle. Chris Pratt and Jack Black bring a lot of energy, and Jack Black's Bowser steals every scene he's in. On the downside, the story is pretty simple and some jokes feel a little flat. Still, if you want a feel-good adventure with your kids or just a nostalgia trip, you'll have a blast.
endingExplained: In the final act, Mario and Luigi reunite and use a special power-up to grow giant and fight Bowser. They manage to shrink him down and trap him in a jar. The brothers are celebrated as heroes in the Mushroom Kingdom, and Mario and Luigi decide to stay and protect their new home. Bowser is locked away, but his defeat hints he could return someday, leaving the door open for more adventures.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves video game adaptations and colorful family adventures.
